landing.heroBadge: Open Source • Clean Slate • Dual API ThumbmarkJS + Fingerprint.com
landing.heroSubtitle: BloumeID is the open-source, zero-dependency replacement for both Fingerprint.com (FingerprintJS Pro) and ThumbmarkJS Pro. 70+ hardware, WebGL2, WebGPU, Audio & Prototype tampering probes paired with an auto-updated MaxMind GeoLite2 + 54,000+ CIDR Radix Trie.
landing.liveWidgetTitle: Your Real-Time Browser, ASN, OS & Risk Score
landing.liveWidgetSubtitle: Executed locally right now by @bloume/id with zero cookies and zero third-party calls.
landing.archTitle: Built for Security Engineers, Not Marketers
landing.archSubtitle: Auditable strict TypeScript, constant-time cryptography, Snowflake IDs, automatic GeoLite2 MMDB sync, and zero runtime dependencies.
landing.bentoReconcileDesc: Reconciles visitors across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Incognito sessions using browser-invariant GPU/Audio/Screen hardwareHash paired with /24 IPv4 and /48 IPv6 subnet correlation.
landing.bentoLevel2: Level 2: HardwareHash + /24 Subnet 30d window (88% cross-browser match)
landing.bentoLevel3: Level 3: Distributed 64-bit Snowflake vis_ assignment (95% confidence)
landing.bentoAntiSpoofDesc: Inspects Function.prototype.toString descriptors on Canvas, AudioBuffer, WebGL and Navigator to catch Multilogin, Dolphin Anty, GoLogin, AdsPower, SwiftShader/llvmpipe VMs, and Playwright CDP.
landing.bentoTrieTitle: Auto-Updated GeoLite2 MMDB + 54k CIDR Radix Trie
landing.bentoTrieDesc: Downloads MaxMind GeoLite2-City & GeoLite2-ASN automatically (via official key or zero-config open mirror) plus X4BNet VPN/Datacenter and Tor exit lists for <1ms local lookups.
landing.bentoCryptoTitle: Custom Security Rules Engine & Dual API
landing.bentoCryptoDesc: Evaluate custom rules (allow, challenge, block, flag) on Tor, VPN, ASN, country, or dangerLevel >= X. Compatible out-of-the-box with both ThumbmarkJS and Fingerprint.com SDK syntax.
landing.compTitle: BloumeID vs. ThumbmarkJS vs. Fingerprint.com vs. CreepJS
landing.compSubtitle: Full feature parity with enterprise fingerprinting SaaS while keeping 100% GDPR/CNIL data sovereignty on your own servers.
landing.compRow3: 70+ Hardware, WebGL2, WebGPU, Audio, Codec & Emoji Signals
landing.compRow5: Local Auto-Updated GeoLite2 + VPN/Tor CIDR Trie (< 1 ms)
landing.compRow6: TLS/JA4, Prototype Hook & Web Worker Anti-Spoof Probes
landing.compRow7: Custom Security Rules (allow/challenge/block), Webhooks & Cap Admin
landing.codeTitle: Drop-In ThumbmarkJS, Fingerprint.com & Coolify Docker Compose
landing.codeSubtitle: Switch in 2 minutes using either SDK interface or deploy in 1 click on Coolify.
landing.footerBuiltBy: Engineered by Bloume SAS • BloumeID MIT Open-Source Software

getStarted.title: Get Started with BloumeID
getStarted.subtitle: Integrate 72+ signal visitor identification, anti-spoofing and threat intelligence in under 3 minutes.
getStarted.step1Title: 1. Select or Create Your Site API Keys
getStarted.step1Desc: Use your public key (bid_pub_...) in the browser and your secret key (bid_sec_...) on your backend server.
getStarted.step2Title: 2. Install the Client SDK (ThumbmarkJS or Fingerprint.com Mode)
getStarted.step3Title: 3. Verify Request & Enforce Security Rules on Your Backend
getStarted.step3Desc: Call verifyRequest(requestId) or GET /api/v1/events/:requestId with your secret key to block bots, Tor and spoofed browsers.
getStarted.step4Desc: Send a live test event right now to verify your database, Redis/Valkey and CIDR threat trie pipeline.
getStarted.testSuccess: Live event verified and stored in pipeline!

webhooksPage.title: Webhooks & HMAC Event Streams (Optional)
webhooksPage.subtitle: Webhooks are 100% optional. Enable them per site only if you want real-time HTTP POST push alerts signed with X-BloumeID-Signature (HMAC-SHA256). Without webhooks, your backend verifies visitors directly via the SDK or REST API.

releasesPage.title: Release Notes & System Changelog
releasesPage.subtitle: Self-hosted platform updates, collector expansions and security engine improvements.
releasesPage.v1Item1: Dual API Drop-in Compatibility: Native support for both ThumbmarkJS Pro (new BloumeID().get()) and Fingerprint.com (FingerprintJS.load().then(fp => fp.get())).
releasesPage.v1Item2: 72 Deterministic Collectors & Anti-Spoof Probes: WebGL 3D pixel hash, WebGPU adapter limits, Unicode/Emoji subpixel TextMetrics, CSS Media matrix, Function.prototype.toString hook detection and VM GPU detection.
releasesPage.v1Item3: Automatic Dual-Mode MaxMind GeoLite2 (.mmdb) Downloader + 54,134 CIDR Radix Trie (< 1 ms in-memory lookups, 0 external API calls per request).
releasesPage.v1Item4: TryCap-Style 176-Country Choropleth World Map, ISP/ASN Network Leaderboard, Custom Security Rules Engine (allow/challenge/block/flag) and 1-Click Coolify Docker Compose.
